title: The Lament of Autumn
summary: Set in the turbulent 1920s, a university student becomes entangled in an assassination case while seeking money for her mother's medical care. She and Yu Changxuan race to solve the mystery as their complicated relationship develops.
whyFans: The period setting contrasts with the mystery at the centre of the story.
An investigation tied to a student's family circumstances provides personal stakes.
The lead pairing gives the romance and mystery threads a shared focus.
review: The Lament of Autumn has the ingredients for a period romance with a mystery engine: a difficult choice, an investigation and two leads drawn into the same chain of events. The story will work best if historical detail supports the mystery rather than simply decorating it. The official premiere, character names and platform still need confirmation from a primary source.
